source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 80,000.00 = 80,000.00. Federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 64,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 80,000.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 80,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 80,000.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 80,000.00, in the band 40,001 to 80,000: 2,150.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,150.00 = 2,150.00. Line 5 = 80,000.00 - 2,150.00 = 77,850.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 77,850.00. Line 8a tax: 77,850.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (77,850.00 - 26,050.00 = 51,800.00) = 342.00 + 1,424.50 = 1,766.50. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 1,766.50. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 80,000.00 - 2,150.00 = 77,850.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 1,766.50 - 0.00 = 1,766.50. State income tax 1,766.50. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 1,767; expected keeps the formula result. The row '$40,001 - $80,000' includes 80,000, so it keeps 2,150.
